metadata.title: Rigidity for Families of Abelian Varieties over $\mathcal{M}_{g,n}$
metadata.abstract: We provide a new proof of Farb's theorem on the global rigidity of the period map $\mathcal{M}_{g,n} \to \mathcal{A}_g$. We extend this classification to essentially include the period map for $\mathcal{M}_{2,n}$. We also provide a classification of holomorphic maps $\mathcal{M}_g \to \mathcal{A}_{h}$ for $h \leq 2g-1$. The only nonconstant maps in this range are given by taking the Jacobian of a curve and attaching a fixed Abelian variety. In addition to the group theory of the mapping class group, we make extensive use of the theory of variations of Hodge structures and the birational geometry on $\overline{\mathcal{M}}_2$.
